name: chicago-style-writing
description: Skill and linter for writing English prose to The Chicago Manual of Style, 18th edition (2024), including the slop patterns that make generated prose sound generic.

plugins.name: chicago-style-writing
plugins.description: Write and edit prose to CMOS 18: sentence clarity, punctuation, hyphenation, numbers, abbreviations, titles, quotations, and citations. Ships a deterministic linter so conformance is checkable.
